Prevention: Avoid susceptible varieties in the hot spots for blast disease, such as
If direct sowing, use seed rate of 15-20 kg/rai
Apply a low amount of nitrogen fertilizer: 16-20-0 not more than 30-35 kg/rai. 46-0-0 less than 10kg/rai
Avoid mono-rice variety (plant two varieties in the same field)
Monitoring: Regularly visit rice field every two weeks (if 5% disease incidence/area, need to control)
Monitor the weather conditions to be prepared for disease outbreak.
Conditions such as temperature (22-25ºC), prolonged period of dew in the morning and windy conditions will be favourable for disease development and epidemic.
Direct Control: Do not apply nitrogen fertiliser if disease observed in seedling stage.
If disease appears, raise the water level (in irrigated area).
Restrictions: Apply when 5% of disease incidence in the rice field.
Rotate the fungicides to prevent resistance
